title: spergularia salina var. australis
intro: Spergularia salina var. australis, commonly known as the coastal sandspurry, is a succulent plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The coastal sandspurry is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antihypertensive properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
